messages:
alex: Quick heads-up  planning to flip on the soft-grace handshake for v1->v2 routing next Tue. It's a non-blocking header negotiation: clients that send `x-client-version: v2-opt-in` get routed to v2, others stay on v1 but we mark them. Need alignment on routing, quota attribution, console UX for exemptions, and telemetry signals.
maria: Are we sure about "non-blocking" semantics? curious about edge cases when v2 has stricter schema (function outputs etc.)  do we validate and fallback or just let errors bubble?
chen: Proposal: validate at the router for obvious contract mismatches (missing required fields) and auto-fallback to v1 with a trace flag: `route.decided=auto-fallback`. We only do deep validation in the canary window. Quick mapping example:
```
# pseudo-router rule
if header.x-client-version == "v2-opt-in": route = v2
else if header.x-client-version == "v2-test" && tenant.exempt == true: route = v2
else: route = v1
```
sam: Telemetry question  what metrics do we emit for counts so billing/quota isn't double counted? need single source of truth.
chen: We'll tag routed requests with `routing_variant=v1|v2` and add `origin_signal=client-header|console-override`. Quota calculation will be directed by `billing.routing_variant` in the token ingestion stage so tokens are only charged once. (Avoids double-counting when we replicate responses.)
alex: Console UX: customers can request a temporary v2 exemption (eg regulated tenants testing). Maria suggested `exempt_until` with expiry. Want a simple toggle + expiry date in console. Also need an API to set per-tenant overrides for automation.
maria: UI needs to show how many requests actually routed vs opted-in. A tiny sparkline and a badge "opt-in traffic: 3.1%" should suffice.
console-bot: NOTE: api: POST /admin/tenants/{id}/overrides {"route_override":"v2","exempt_until":"2026-05-01T00:00:00Z"}
chen: Implementation caveat: overrides should be enforced at the gateway early. Also add a TTL eviction so stale overrides don't linger.
sam: Dashboards: can we standardize the metric names? Suggest `routing.requests.total`, `routing.requests.by_variant`, `routing.fallbacks.total`, `routing.override.count` and a label `tenant_id`.
alex: Rollout plan
- Mon: enable canary (1% traffic) for 24h, collect `fallback_rate` and `error_rcp`
- Tue: open console opt-in for internal tenants (10%)
- Wed: enable public soft-grace (50%) with rollback monitors
- Kill switch: console toggle + api `POST /admin/rollouts/kill`
maria: What's our alerting threshold? I'd set `fallback_rate > 0.5%` OR `p99.latency increase > 20%` as blockers.
chen: Agree. Also add `schema-mismatch` logs sampled at 1% with full payloads saved to s3 for quick triage.
alex: Quota enforcement detail: if a request is routed to v2 but auto-fallbacks to v1, charge based on actual model used. Need post-route attestation event: `billing.route_final=v1|v2` emitted before accounting.
sam: For dashboards, quick Grafana query for canary:
```
sum(rate(routing_requests_total{routing_variant="v2",job="gateway"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(routing_requests_total{job="gateway"}[5m]))
```
maria: Ops question: if a tenant sets `exempt_until` via API, do we log that to the audit log? must be auditable for enterprise customers.
alex: Yes  override events go to audit + tenant-change stream. console-bot: AUDIT: tenant 348 set override v2 until 2026-06-01 by maria
ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 2026-04-14 02:00 UTC. Will run gateway rollout + canary config push. @alex @chen @sam assigned.
sam: One small UX ask  console should show an "impact preview": given current traffic patterns, estimate expected v2 traffic if toggle enabled. We can compute with last 7d header signal.
chen: I'd prefer we do soft-trace initially: replica header capture without routing for 24h to estimate real opt-in footprint. Add a flag `dry_capture=true` and store counts.
alex: Action items list:
- chen: implement header rules + billing attestation event (ETA Tue)
- sam: dashboards + alerts (ETA Mon)
- maria: console toggle + expiry UI + audit (ETA Mon)
- ops-bot: schedule deploy + runbook (done)
Everyone: quick thumbs? :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
chen: LGTM
sam: :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks  proceeding with dry-capture tomorrow, will post results here.
